episodes.title: This Is Not New York
episodes.summary: Somalia, 1993. An effort to end famine and civil war turns violent when a US mission to take out a rebel leader ends in the death of multiple civilians.

episodes.title: A Wall of Lead
episodes.summary: A routine raid to capture two of Aidid's lieutenants turns into a chaotic rescue operation when the Army Rangers are met with fierce Somali counterfire.

episodes.title: No Way Out
episodes.summary: As news of the botched Black Hawk operation rattles America, video of a captive pilot shocks the globe. Will he be rescued?
